decisions.reason: Batteryless USB operation does not alter the required current capacity of the VBUS and battery copper paths when their respective loads are present.
This Requirement covers the separate main-board LDO used when the power board is absent; the source decision concerns USB operation through the AXP2101 power path without a battery.
Allowing the AXP2101 system to operate from USB without a battery does not change the 5V rail loads, GPIO control, or shutdown behavior.
The added power-source mode does not change the existing requirement to transfer heat from the AXP2101 through its exposed pad and PCB.
The source establishes batteryless USB operation but does not change which rails must be monitored, the monitoring IC, or measurement coverage.
Supporting operation without a battery does not remove or modify the battery connector needed when a battery is used.
The source does not change the DCDC1 voltage setting, target rail voltage, compensation rationale, or regulation condition.
Batteryless USB operation does not modify the panel button connector, PWRON connection, or on/off control behavior.
The ESP32 decoupling requirements remain valid regardless of whether the upstream AXP2101 supply is operating from USB or a battery.
Operation without a battery does not remove the supported battery configuration or change the existing connector, antenna, or enclosure-layout constraints.
The ability to operate without a battery does not entail removing the battery from the intended enclosure or changing its mounting requirements.
The AXP2101 input-power mode has no effect on the selected ESP32 module, pin breakout, pitch, or full-pin-access requirement.
